title: The Covenant at Galeed
reflectionText: Jacob and Laban ended a bitter dispute by naming clear boundaries before God and sharing a meal beside the stones they raised. Their covenant did not erase the past, but it stopped further harm. Where might a truthful boundary open a path toward peace without pretending that trust is effortless?
editorialNotes: Packet 021 initial writer output. Short-only plan. The retelling remains within Genesis 31:43-55 and preserves the covenant, stone witnesses, shared meal, and peaceful departure without importing the preceding dispute.
